description: Defines the ClaimRequestSummaryModel class, which is part of the OrangeHRM claim API module. The class models a summarized view of a ClaimRequest entity, including properties for 'id' and 'referenceId' used for API serialization.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSummaryModel
classes.description: A model class used for representing a summary of a claim request in API responses, implementing normalization functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ClaimRequest entity and sets up the relevant filters and attribute names for serialization.
